subject: Quick feedback on wording direction
text:
Hey everyone,

I wanted to tap into the group for some quick feedback before I revise the landing page. The brief mentioned “make the messaging more inviting,” but I keep thinking that could mean warmer color choices, shorter headlines, or a friendlier tone in the callouts. I do not want to guess wrong and send the whole thing back out.

Which reading makes the most sense to you? If you have examples of wording you like, even rough ones, that would help a lot. I can send two options by the end of the day once I know what direction feels clearest and move forward confidently today.
